value.rationale: The canonical all-dimensional complete-graph root polytope is a meaningful invariant-bearing family. The complete finite facet area spectrum determines the exact area-weighted sampling distribution and exposes variance n/8 versus n/4 under uniform facet choice. The sharp tangency-deficit 1/(4n) quantifies boundary support geometry and is not a routine renaming of known volume or f-vector. The result has useful structural content without claiming any universal extension.
